title: Protect loading lists participants and trade documents with live customer scope
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce enabled current user, existing loading-list menu and authoritative current customer scope before list counts/detail/timeline/participants/options/trade-document generation and every write/state route. For multi-customer documents require access to every effective participant customer and relevant explicit upstream customer to avoid leaking another customer through shared shipment. Legacy single-customer scope uses persisted CustomerId; missing authoritative ownership is denied for restricted users. Unrestricted authorized users keep compatible access; do not create grants or infer ownership from numbers.

Validate complete proposed customer/participants/upstream scope before changing tracked fields, replacing details or setting primary participant. Use compatible existing preloading/list row locks and atomic transaction for writes and state changes; denied maintenance preserves all data and original audit. Retain ERP348 cumulative quantity, live eligible source and downstream evidence semantics; never post stock or finance. Verify actual controller/service SQL own/foreign/mixed participant documents, revoked menu, disabled user, export denial, failed edit unchanged and participant edit racing approval.
